items.title: Endogenous Alignment Requires Dependence
items.summary: My post on endogenous alignment got several excellent comments. items.title: Graph-centric agentic intelligence
items.summary: Graphs encode relationships. In a world where AI agents need to reason about complex systems, not just retrieve information, graph structure provides the scaffolding for causal inference, dependency tracking, and compositional reasoning.
